question: How can zirconium metal-organic framework materials be modified to improve ion adsorption capacity and selectivity?
answer: Zirconium metal-organic framework materials can be modified by incorporating ion-binding units such as NH2, SH, COOH, HCl, OH, and SO4 into their frameworks. Additionally, hybrid materials combining zirconium metal-organic frameworks with polymers or graphene oxide can be developed, and new zirconium metal-organic frameworks with versatile pore structures and functional units can be synthesized. These strategies enhance ion adsorption capacity and selectivity by optimizing interactions between the framework and targeted ions.

The paper aims to review recent advancements in the development and application of zirconium metal-organic framework (Zr-MOF) materials for ion adsorption and ion sieving in industrial separation processes.
